title: Printable contest PDF
description: Configure the printed paper for this contest. Changes are a local draft — nothing is saved to the server.
unsupportedTitle: PDF generation is not supported in this browser
unsupportedDescription: Generating the PDF needs Web Workers and WebAssembly. You can still edit the draft, but compiling the paper requires a modern browser.
settingsDescription: Contest metadata printed on the cover and info pages.
fieldLanguageDescription: Used to pick each problem's statement; problems without it fall back to another language.
fieldNoticeDescription: Markdown printed on the cover page.
fieldNoiStyleDescription: Use NOI-style wording and section layout.
fieldFileIoDescription: Describe input and output files in the overview table.
fieldUsePretestDescription: Print the pretest row and section.
languagesDescription: Rows printed in the submission table, one per judge language.
extraSectionsDescription: Markdown sections printed after the problems.
problemsDescription: Print order and per-problem overrides for the paper.
emptyProblemsDescription: Every problem was removed from the paper. Use the add-problem control to include one again.
emptyPdictDescription: This contest does not contain any problems yet.
fieldProblemNameDescription: ASCII identifier used as the default directory and executable name.
previewDescription: Compile the paper in your browser and preview it here.
outdatedHint: The draft changed after this PDF was generated — generate again to refresh it.
previewPlaceholderDescription: Generate the PDF to preview and download the paper. Compilation runs entirely in your browser.
previewAutoDescription: The preview updates automatically after you edit the paper.
